title: Checkpoint decision log record
description: One record per agentic decision point. The agent side and the human side share a single decision_id, so a team can show not only what the agent did, but why a person was brought in, what they saw, and how they decided.

decision_id.description: Stable identifier linking both sides of the record.

agent.description: Agent-side record: what was proposed and how it was scored.

proposed_action.description: Plain-language description of the action at this decision point.

inputs.description: Checkpoint Scale v1.0 dimension scores, each 1 to 5.

confidence_source.description: Where the confidence value came from. Observable signals are preferred over model self-report.

rationale.description: Plain-language reason naming the dimensions that drove the route.

human.description: Human-side record. Present when the route is hold_for_human, or when a logged action is later reviewed.

shown_to_reviewer.description: What the reviewer actually saw at the moment of decision.

reasoning_cue.description: The prompt used to move the reviewer from autopilot into deliberate checking.

stated_rationale.description: The reviewer's own reason, in their words.
